summary: REI3 is an open-source platform designed to help businesses track internal operations such as tasks, working time, and asset inventories. Built using Go and released under the MIT licence, it provides a centralised system for administrative record-keeping. The software acts as a modular framework where various business processes can be managed in one place.
goodFor: It is a suitable choice for small organisations seeking a self-hosted, customisable tool to manage internal administrative workflows without relying on proprietary SaaS platforms.
watchOut: The project has a modest community and moderate maintenance activity, meaning you may encounter less third-party documentation and fewer ready-made integrations compared to more established enterprise alternatives.
deployNotes: Because it is written in Go, deployment typically involves running a single compiled binary behind a reverse proxy for TLS termination. You will also need to configure persistent storage and a separate database backend to handle application data.
